title: COMPLEX
body:
You made it underground. Now climb out. The robots
built a research complex into the rock: specimen labs,
a robotics workshop, a server vault and a drone bay,
stacked floor on floor up to the surface lift. Mind
the lab staff; they have been optimized. Lab Hunters
roam every wing and come together when one finds you.
Two bulkheads stand in the way. Their terminals don't.
